Zuckerberg's own answer contains the quote word for word: "Hopefully, sometime later in the year we'll get to roll out the 405B. For where it is right now in training, it is already at around 85 MMLU and we expect that it's going to have leading benchmarks on a bunch of the benchmarks." The only difference is a hyperlink on "MMLU". He says this just before mentioning that the 70B is "releasing today", which fits the Llama 3 launch.

2. **Looks forward and is about AI: met.** The product is an AI system, the Llama 3 405B model. He says when it will be released and what it will do: lead on several benchmarks. This isn't a plain hardware date or a business forecast. "Hopefully" is only a hedge word, so the claim is scored as stated with the hedge kept in `prediction`.
3. **Date: met.** "Sometime later in the year" means the end of 2024, a stage with its own end. It isn't an open-ended phrase like "the coming months".
4. **Primary source: met.** A transcript of the interview.

**Not already recorded.** None of his recorded files is this claim. The closest is 2024-07-23-zuckerberg-llama-most-advanced-next-year, which was said three months later and is about the following year's model.
